title: Visual Derivative Worker
objective: Implement governed visual derivative generation for reusable resources while preserving source identity, lineage and ARI-11 use-capability enforcement.

changed_since_previous: ARI-11 reached completed_verified and its authority was retired
ARI-12 became the canonical strict successor

owner_sequence_authorization.source: Explicit owner instruction in this execution on 2026-09-10
owner_sequence_authorization.rule: Execute strictly in order; each unit retains its own bounded scope, validation, integration, closeout, and strict-successor selection.

selection_boundaries: ARI-11 is completed_verified and owns evidence-backed rights/license/use-capability evaluation and downstream filtering.
ARI-12 implements only governed visual derivative generation and must respect ARI-11 capability decisions and ARI-03 lineage semantics.
Source identity, lineage and original bytes remain preserved; derivative generation does not grant rights, provider entitlement, redistribution or commercial permission.
ARI-13 audio derivative work and all later ARI implementation remain inactive until ARI-12 is completed_verified.
